description: The stored copy of a step result (schema step-result) plus what the hook adds: .factory/local/runs/<run>/steps/<workflow>/<subject>/<name>.<attempt>.json (record step). A $ref to step-result beside this schema's own type and properties, with agent_type, worktree_head and agent_id added (plan decision D3). Not tracked; written only through vsdd.state.steps.store_step. Cap 64,000 bytes.

agent_type.description: The calling agent's type, carried from the hook payload.

worktree_head.description: The commit the step left its worktree at, as the step-results rule read it.

agent_id.description: The calling agent's id, empty for the main session. A second write to the same step key is accepted only from the same agent_id or with identical content (decision D4).

grounded.description: Present when the step-results rule grounded the record's findings; false marks a finding that stayed ungrounded.
